title: Snowy Mountain Adventure
moral: Courage and clever thinking help overcome challenges.

scenes.summary: Alex begins his journey to find a treasure on a mountain.

story: Alex saw a treasure on a snowy mountain and set out on an adventure. He crossed icy caves with the help of a squirrel. Suddenly, an avalanche buried the treasure. Thinking cleverly, Alex built a snowman to help dig it out. He found the treasure and returned home happily, proud of his courage and smart thinking.
